name: @rancher/shell-eslint-legacy
description: Isolated ESLint 7 (eslintrc) toolchain shipped by @rancher/shell. Extensions that still use a legacy `.eslintrc.*` config are linted with this self-contained toolchain, selected automatically by `scripts/lint`. Kept in its own folder (with its own node_modules, installed on demand) so its plugin versions never collide with the flat-config ESLint 10 toolchain in the main @rancher/shell dependencies. Do not add this to the monorepo workspaces.
